text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (——I thought it would be soon.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Soon. ...Soon, everyone, everything.
...That everything would go back to normal.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (Then why——)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Sooooo hot~. Hey, Trainer! Over here, over here~!
Ice cream, let's get ice cream———! Treat me~♡
choice_data_list: This is why you messaged me on LANE?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Because, well, Ku-chan-senpai seems kinda out of it.
It's pretty warm. Maybe summer heat's getting to her? Sooo~
I figured ice cream is a must! Don't ya think?☆
choice_data_list: That's a weird conclusion you came to

text_block_list.text:
Well, both of you have been working hard for your autumn races,
so ice cream sounds good. Did you pick what to get?

Well, both of you have been working hard for your autumn races,
so ice cream sounds good. Did you pick what to get?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
'Course! I know exactly what senpai likes☆
C'mon, let's go, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
We're baaaack~♪ Senpai, got ice cream!
Let's eat some ice cream and recharge——

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
——Senpai? ...Ku-chan-senpai?
............Are you asleep?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(At first, thought it was normal.
Like dozing off after sunbathing.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (Just looked fast asleep.)
Kraft! ...Kraft, wake up! Kraft!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey. Don't you think this is strange?
No matter what... this isn't right...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (For some reason... things just kept getting weirder.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (More and more...——)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Just stranger and weirder...
And then, finally.)

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry. We did every test and did all we could,
but... cause remains unknown...

No way...! S-She was completely fine just yesterday!
Why suddenly like this...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (And just like that.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (Ku-chan-senpai didn't wake up.)

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Wait... what's this news?
...Rhein Kraft collapsed...?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What does that mean? She was fine just recently...
Didn't she announce she's entering Sprinters Stakes next?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
No way... why?
Not now... wasn't she just getting started...?

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Can't be real, right...?
Seriously... she won't wake up...?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(News about senpai spread instantly.
...So many people visited her. Every day.)

...Ah, guys——Thank you.
You came again today...

...Ah, guys——Thank you.
You came again today...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it. We wanted to come.
...More importantly, are you holding up? Getting enough rest?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Especially Trainer-san. You've been here every day, right?
So... how is Kraft-san doing...?
...No change. She's... still asleep.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Senpai's room was always packed with people worried sick,
day in and day out. Every single day.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (Every day. ...We were there too.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Held her hand, pinched her cheek, poked her forehead.
Called her name, prayed, screamed out loud.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Called her dummy, sleepyhead, said everything we could.
——Even so.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (Senpai still, still... wouldn't wake up.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...What?

Honestly... not sure you're in state to focus on racing.
So... I'll leave participating up to you——

Honestly... not sure you're in state to focus on racing.
So... I'll leave participating up to you——

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Huh? I'm running!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I'm running, don't be stupid!
Because... I promised her...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I made promise with senpai! At next Shuka Sho for sure!
I'll win, and show senpai!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: "One more time," "one more time," as many times as it takes——

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Until I win! By never giving up and keeping on running——!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...That's right. Senpai and I already decided.
"Whatever happens," "no matter what"... never give up.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
That's why... that's why I'm running Shuka Sho.
Definitely running. And winning!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I'll show senpai I can win...!

I need to get it together too. Let's work hard together
for Shuka Sho. For Kraft... let's win for her...!

I need to get it together too. Let's work hard together
for Shuka Sho. For Kraft... let's win for her...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ...Please, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Ku-chan-senpai. ...I'll win.
I'll keep our promise for sure. Absolutely!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (So... senpai.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (Just watch me——!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa...! 
Trainer, next!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I can keep going.
Still got plenty in tank, no problem!

(Pandora... that's it, keep at it, Pandora...!
I'll support that unyielding drive of yours!)

(Pandora... that's it, keep at it, Pandora...!
I'll support that unyielding drive of yours!)

(Then we'll show Kraft! That you can win...
Claim that Autumn Tiara she couldn't reach!)

(Then we'll show Kraft! That you can win...
Claim that Autumn Tiara she couldn't reach!)
...And then, the Shuka Sho——

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
From the inside, Fusaichi Pandora pushes forward!
Fusaichi Pandora closes in on the lead!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
But charging outside is Kawakami Princess!
Here she comes, here comes Kawakami Princess!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Unstoppable momentum! Kawakami Princess is strong!
And now, she crosses the line!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Haa-...! Haa, haa, haa, *cough*...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...~~~Aaaargh!
Dammiiiit...!

Gave everything at Shuka Sho. But Kawakami Princess proved
overwhelmingly strong. Finished in 3rd...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Sorry, senpai. Shuka Sho... I lost.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Our promise... couldn't keep it...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
...Were you talking with doctor just now?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: About Ku-chan-senpai... what did they say?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Tell me.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Please. I want to know too.
——Please.
I had them run test after test…… They checked all medical precedent too…… And their conclusion was——

Kraft regaining consciousness……
They say the odds are practically zero.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ……I see.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Got it. ……Thanks. And sorry.

I…… couldn't find anything to tell her.
Not a single word came out.
Damn it! Damn it all……!

She fought through so much hardship!
Yet I couldn't even help her take Rose S or Shuka Sho……!
Just drowning in self-pity. Head knows wallowing fixes nothing…… but watching Rhein Kraft lying there asleep——
——I stop. Seeing "Her"…… after so long.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Long time no see, Trainer.
How is Kraft……——

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ……Kraft. Ah——how did this happen——
choice_data_list: ……Sorry. Even though I was with her——
……Sorry. Even though I was with her——

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
…………No. No——forgive me.
Did not come here just to weep.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Did not come to wallow or reminisce. ……"We shall meet again in that promised future." That was our vow.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: More importantly…… Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: There is something I need you to see.
